source_excerpt: After years of searching, I FINALLY managed to snag an unopened iam8bit INSIDE Collector's Edition on eBay

purchase_claim.statement: Public commenter says they won an eBay auction for an unopened INSIDE CE at $400 with free shipping. Says auction began $400, dozens watched, no other bids. They also report a separate CE sold three days after their birthday in September for $380, and two sales in less than 30 days.

recommendation: Give raezores original public comment ID and auction claims for reconciliation with their October 2026 seller listing records, but do not claim a new copy or serial until an original listing, serial or transfer chain is established.
